milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward and face the iron ore cluster at the back-right corner of the cave (spawn-relative [4, 1, -5]). max_distance=16 covers the room since it's only 17x17, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actively looking at the ore rather than accidentally triggering it. The player spawns facing the opposite direction (toward the wall at +Z), so they must deliberately turn around.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_cobblestone_wall with a pickaxe drops the block itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player has a diamond pickaxe equipped and must break at least one block from the full-width barrier at Z=3. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item reliably appears in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting orange_stained_glass (8 glass + 1 orange dye = 8 orange stained glass) places the result directly in the player's inventory. The player has 8 glass and 8 orange dye, and the recipe yields exactly 8 orange stained glass per craft. The crafting table behind the wall provides the required 3x3 grid.
